checks.method: Inspected retained BHL primary theorem text, pinned Solution.lean declarations, formalization metadata and archive branch response; evaluated the displayed bound with exact rational arithmetic.
checks.observation: A 68-member four-uniform family needs support N>=8 because choose(7,4)=35. The BHL bound at three petals is 3(863/432)^N, already approximately 760.918 at N=8 and increasing. It does not directly yield 67. Solution.lean uses support parameter N; the matching archive reports commit 8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7. Metadata disclaims registry endorsement; no transitive proof audit was performed here.
